anchor_key.description: Where its signed copy is in the anchors' write-once bucket.

approval.description: The setting change that switched the purge after retention on, under dual control.

boundary.description: ledger: the first day kept whole; every report from it on is unchanged, and an earlier day is refused (BALANCE-PURGED).

carried_revision.description: ledger: the ledger revision after the carry-forward; an "as at" revision before it is refused.

counts.description: What it purged and kept: events and security events, or entries and lines purged and kept and carry-forward entries.

kind.description: trail: the audit trail's events up to last_seq (AUD-09). ledger: a financial year's entries, carried forward to the boundary (AUD-10).

last_seq.description: trail: the last event purged; verification starts after it.
